rows: DOP hard cheese aged 24 months, nutty and crystalline.
Short-grain Italian rice high in amylopectin, ideal for risotto.
Fresh Tuber melanosporum, aromatic and earthy.
Mixed varietal tomatoes with balanced acidity.
Bring vegetable stock to a gentle simmer and keep warm over low heat.
Sweat finely diced shallots in butter until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Add arborio rice and stir to coat, cooking until the edges turn glassy.
Deglaze with white wine and reduce until nearly dry.
Ladle warm stock one cup at a time, stirring until absorbed before the next addition.
Finish off heat with cold butter, grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, and shaved truffle.
Halve tomatoes, toss with olive oil, and roast at 200C for 35 minutes.
Sweat onions and garlic, then add roasted tomatoes and stock; simmer 25 minutes.
Mound flour, make a well, and incorporate eggs and yolks gradually.
Knead 10 minutes, rest 30 minutes, then roll and cut into ribbons.
Whisk olive oil, eggs, and sugar until pale, then fold in flour and zest.
Bake at 175C for 40 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Original test-kitchen batch; slightly loose consistency.
Baseline bisque with roasted heirloom tomatoes.
Standard 00 flour dough, rolled to setting 6.
Olive oil cake using Meyer lemons.
